_readme: THE KIMI NIGHT. Four minds on your own tinybox, plus one scripted control.
MEASURED, NOT GUESSED — kimi-k2.6 on this box ALWAYS reasons. Fourteen ways
of asking it not to were tried and every one was ignored: reasoning_effort
{enabled:false}, think:false, /no_think and /nothink suffixes, and a system
prompt telling it plainly not to deliberate. It spends 1,100-1,800
characters thinking about which verb to pick, every single time.
So the budget has to cover the thinking AND the answer. maxTokens 3000 is
measured: at 1024 it ran out mid-thought and returned an EMPTY answer, at
2048 it ran out 3 times in 4, and at 3000 it finished twice in two, in 8.5s
and 20s. timeoutSeconds 60 covers the slow end; cadenceSeconds 25 stops a
second question being asked before the first is answered.
Iseabail is scripted ON PURPOSE. When a Kimi does something startling, she
is how you tell whether that was the model or just the world.

players.name: Coinneach
players.character: You are blunt and certain. You say what you think of the others' plans out loud, and you would rather be usefully wrong than politely quiet.

players.name: Mairi
players.character: You hoard. Firewood and meat are yours once you have touched them, and you do not share a fire — though you will trade hard for something you want.

players.name: Dùghall
players.character: You lie about where the deer are. Not out of malice — you just want to get there first, and you will happily send someone the wrong way over a ridge.

players.name: Seònaid
players.character: You are generous and slow to notice you are being used. You share food unprompted and you believe what people tell you about where the deer are.

players.name: Iseabail
players.character: The control — no model, no key, no network. Do not remove her: when a Kimi does something startling, she is the reference for whether that was the model or the world.
